records.text: --- Source: P3109/D1 4.12-4.13.1, printed page 53-57.
fmod P3109-PREDICATES is
including P3109-FORMAT-QUERIES .
including P3109-OMEGA-ARITHMETIC .
sorts ClassEnum .
ops ClsNaN ClsNegativeInfinity ClsNegativeNormal ClsNegativeSubnormal ClsZero ClsPositiveSubnormal ClsPositiveNormal ClsPositiveInfinity : -> ClassEnum [ctor] .
ops CompareLess CompareLessEqual CompareEqual CompareGreaterEqual CompareGreater : Format Format Int Int ~> Bool .
ops IsZero IsOne IsNaN IsInfinite IsFinite IsSignMinus IsNormal IsSubnormal : Format Int ~> Bool .
op Class : Format Int ~> ClassEnum .
vars F G : Format .
vars C D : Int .
ceq [p3109-predicates-001] : CompareLess(F, G, C, D) = xLt(decode(F, C), decode(G, D)) if validCode(F, C) /\ validCode(G, D) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-002] : CompareLessEqual(F, G, C, D) = xLe(decode(F, C), decode(G, D)) if validCode(F, C) /\ validCode(G, D) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-003] : CompareEqual(F, G, C, D) = xEq(decode(F, C), decode(G, D)) if validCode(F, C) /\ validCode(G, D) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-004] : CompareGreaterEqual(F, G, C, D) = xLe(decode(G, D), decode(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) /\ validCode(G, D) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-005] : CompareGreater(F, G, C, D) = xLt(decode(G, D), decode(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) /\ validCode(G, D) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-006] : IsZero(F, C) = xEq(decode(F, C), fin(0)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-007] : IsOne(F, C) = xEq(decode(F, C), fin(1)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-008] : IsNaN(F, C) = xNaN(decode(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-009] : IsInfinite(F, C) = xInfinite(decode(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-010] : IsFinite(F, C) = xFinite(decode(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-011] : IsSignMinus(F, C) = xMinus(decode(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .

fields.label: p3109-predicates-012
fields.condition: validCode(F, C) /\ (IsZero(F, C) or IsInfinite(F, C) or IsNaN(F, C))

records.text: ceq [p3109-predicates-012] : IsNormal(F, C) = false if validCode(F, C) /\ (IsZero(F, C) or IsInfinite(F, C) or IsNaN(F, C)) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .

fields.label: p3109-predicates-013
fields.condition: validCode(F, C) /\ IsFinite(F, C) /\ not IsZero(F, C)

records.text: ceq [p3109-predicates-013] : IsNormal(F, C) = xLe(decode(F, MinNormalOf(F)), omegaAbs(decode(F, C))) if validCode(F, C) /\ IsFinite(F, C) /\ not IsZero(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .

fields.label: p3109-predicates-014
fields.rhs: (IsFinite(F, C) and not IsZero(F, C) and not IsNormal(F, C))

records.text: ceq [p3109-predicates-014] : IsSubnormal(F, C) = (IsFinite(F, C) and not IsZero(F, C) and not IsNormal(F, C)) if validCode(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-015] : Class(F, C) = ClsNaN if validCode(F, C) /\ IsNaN(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
ceq [p3109-predicates-016] : Class(F, C) = ClsZero if validCode(F, C) /\ IsZero(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .

fields.label: p3109-predicates-017
fields.rhs: if IsSignMinus(F, C) then ClsNegativeInfinity else ClsPositiveInfinity fi

records.text: ceq [p3109-predicates-017] : Class(F, C) = if IsSignMinus(F, C) then ClsNegativeInfinity else ClsPositiveInfinity fi if validCode(F, C) /\ IsInfinite(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .

fields.label: p3109-predicates-018
fields.rhs: if IsSignMinus(F, C) then ClsNegativeNormal else ClsPositiveNormal fi

records.text: ceq [p3109-predicates-018] : Class(F, C) = if IsSignMinus(F, C) then ClsNegativeNormal else ClsPositiveNormal fi if validCode(F, C) /\ IsNormal(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .

fields.label: p3109-predicates-019
fields.rhs: if IsSignMinus(F, C) then ClsNegativeSubnormal else ClsPositiveSubnormal fi

records.text: ceq [p3109-predicates-019] : Class(F, C) = if IsSignMinus(F, C) then ClsNegativeSubnormal else ClsPositiveSubnormal fi if validCode(F, C) /\ IsSubnormal(F, C) [metadata "clause=4.12-4.13.1; page=53-57"] .
